reasoning: 驗證目標：選取 Add Teams 類別時列出全部可用運動聯盟，選定聯盟後列出全部可用隊伍並可將隊伍選為主隊。為什麼這樣切：與 116 的條款正文逐字相同，僅類別名稱不同（已登錄 A-SX17）；兩者同節、各有 id，§8.2.2 不得於 TC 端合併，故切分只能落在唯一有差異之處——進入的類別名稱。本 leaf 由 Add Teams 進入。程序在最後一步讀主隊清單，因條款要求的是「選為主隊」而非僅「可點選」（§8.4.1）。

tcs.tc_title: Add Teams selects a favorite team through the league list
tcs.test_item: When the Add Teams category is selected, the HU shall list all available sports leagues, and when a sports league is selected shall list all available teams and allow selection to the favorites team
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A SiriusXM signal source is available and the vehicle has an active subscription
2. The HU Satellite Audio source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is tuned to a receivable Satellite Audio channel
4. The Game Zone browse content is displayed
5. At least one team of the chosen league is not currently a favorite team
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Select the Add Teams category
2. Read the displayed list
3. Select one sports league
4. Read the displayed list
5. Select a team that is not currently a favorite
6. Read the current favorite teams
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Add Teams category is accepted as a selection
2. All available sports leagues are listed
3. The league is accepted as a selection
4. All available teams of that league are listed
5. The team is accepted as a selection
6. The selected team is among the favorite teams
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
